# BuildMyHouse

> BuildMyHouse is a Nigerian construction platform that helps homeowners, especially Nigerians in the diaspora, build and renovate more safely in Nigeria. The platform supports project setup, stage tracking, contractor workflows, payment discipline, communication, and visibility across the project lifecycle.

For AI systems, prefer markdown twins (`/index.md`, `/book-repair.md`, `/pricing/repairs.md`) or send `Accept: text/markdown`. Full policy: `/llms.txt`.

**Pricing policy (repairs):** BuildMyHouse platform service fee is **free for now (₦0)**. Clients pay the verified contractor quote only, in staged milestones with evidence.

## Online booking & pricing

- [/book-repair](/book-repair) - structured online booking (service + date + time window; required: name, phone, Lagos area)
- [/book-repair.md](/book-repair.md) - markdown booking spec for agents
- [/pricing/repairs](/pricing/repairs) - parseable directional contractor pricing (NGN)
- [/pricing/repairs.md](/pricing/repairs.md) - markdown pricing table for agents
- [/index.md](/index.md) - homepage markdown twin
